Legacy pages still carry useful text

Older pages often contain layout tables, missing closing tags, and inline scripts. A tolerant parser can still produce a tree that lets the extraction algorithm find the central sequence of paragraphs.

The production path decodes bytes before parsing so a declared character set does not become mojibake. It then parses once and shares the immutable source tree with extraction and metadata fallback.

Malformed input should lead to a weak result or a clean error, never a process crash. This fixture deliberately omits several closing elements.
